title: fix(fields): lookup picker is wide enough to read an option and stays inside the viewport
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Part of #34601 (item 1 lands here; item 2 is traced below and ends as an open question for the seat, so merging this must not close the card)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：查找字段的下拉面板不再和触发它的格子一样窄：最窄 18rem，触发器更宽时跟随触发器，最宽不超过视口可用宽度。
- 为什么改：行项目表格里的产品列很窄，下拉面板跟着变窄，产品名被截成「Data Migr…」，分不清选的是哪个产品。
- 风险与回滚：只改了一处样式类，不碰查找的数据、搜索和筛选；回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` 里 `PopoverContent` 的 className（宽度三件套）；其次是测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：在报价单行项目表格里点开产品下拉，应能看到每个产品的完整名称；把浏览器缩到手机宽度（375px）再点开，下拉不超出屏幕右边。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `LookupField`'s quick-pick popover (`data-testid="lookup-popover"`) keeps `w-[var(--radix-popover-trigger-width)]` and gains two classes:
  - `min-w-[min(18rem,var(--radix-popover-content-available-width,100vw))]`: a floor, so a narrow trigger (a compact line-item grid cell, or an inline cell editor) no longer gives a narrow list. The floor is itself capped by the available width with `min()`, because a `min-width` larger than the `max-width` wins over it.
  - `max-w-(--radix-popover-content-available-width)`: never wider than the room Radix reports, so a narrow screen keeps the panel inside the viewport.
- Applies to every lookup trigger, compact or not. For a trigger already wider than 18rem nothing changes. Both compact call sites benefit: `GridField`'s lookup cell and `FieldEditWidget` (`COMPACT_EDIT_TYPES`, used by inline cell editing in object grids).
- The card suggested 16rem. Measured against the catalog the report came from (hotcrm's product seed), 16rem still cut the longest name, "ObjectStack Platform (SMB Edition)", by 6px (228px of text in 222px). 18rem fits it. 18rem is also the floor `FieldTypePicker` already uses.
- `align="start"` and Radix's default collision handling are unchanged. Measured: a widened panel opened from a right-edge cell shifts left and stays on screen.
- Out of scope, as the card says: what a lookup searches, filters or stores.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in `LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx`, beside the existing popover-bounds describe (objectstack#34362). It pins the three width classes for a compact trigger and for a full-size one. jsdom has no layout, so the pixels were read in Chromium (Verification below). The harness's `openPicker` gains an optional `{ compact }` argument.
- Ablation (one run, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, source is imported relatively so no dist leg): deleting the two new classes from the committed `LookupField.tsx` turned both new tests red (`popover lacks min-w-[min(18rem,...)]`, 2 failed / 17 passed). The file was restored to the HEAD blob `0d4e6d38cb3b`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards. The first attempt used `--replacement ''`, which the tool refused before running anything; it was a no-op, and the `--delete` rerun is the reading.

## Acceptance notes

- Names longer than the 18rem list still truncate (the label span keeps `truncate`), and a truncated option carries no `title`. With the reported catalog every name fits. Whether long names should wrap or show a tooltip is a separate design choice and is not changed here.
- Item 2 (why the Product column is narrower than the 168px minimum) is traced below. Inside this PR's surface (`GridField`) nothing produces a lookup column under 168px except an author-pinned `width`. The likely source of the reported 65px column is a different surface, outside this PR's surface and not measured live.

## Item 2 trace: where a lookup column under 168px comes from

- `GridField`: `widthStyle` gives an unpinned lookup column `width` = `minWidth` = 168 (`MIN_WIDTH_BY_TYPE.lookup`). Measured in Chromium on the real component: the column is 168px at a 375px viewport and 281px at 1280px (the table stretches). A column goes under 168 only when it pins `width`: pinned 65, it measured 68px at 375px.
- No platform producer derives a column `width`: `hydrateColumns` (plugin-form), `deriveMasterDetail` and spec `deriveInlineGridColumns` write none, so a narrow grid column is always author metadata.
- hotcrm at `18e18329` (read-only clone): `quote_line_item` declares no `inlineEdit` and no grid column `width`. The `crm_quote` relationship curates `relatedListColumns` with `crm_product` and no width. So `GridField` at `origin/main` does not produce a 65px Product column from hotcrm's metadata.
- The second compact call site is `FieldEditWidget`, used by inline cell editing in object grids. There, `data-table` auto-sizes a column with no `width` from what it drew (`autoWidthKey`), so an empty Product column takes its header's width. That fits the reported ~65px, but it was NOT MEASURED in a running hotcrm instance. The popover change here covers that path as well.
- Left for the seat: (a) whether `GridField` should floor an author-pinned `width` at the type minimum, which changes what `width` means to an author; (b) whether the `data-table` auto-width needs a floor for lookup columns. That is `@object-ui/components`, outside this PR's surface.

## Verification

<details><summary>Chromium readings (real GridField + LookupField, console Vite dev server, temporary harness removed after the run)</summary>

Options: hotcrm's 13 catalog product names. "before" = the same page with the new min/max overridden away (trigger width only).

| viewport | column | trigger | popover before | names cut before | popover after | names cut after | inside viewport after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 | pinned 65 (132 laid out) | 124 | 124 | 13/13 | 288 | 0/13 | yes |
| 375 | unpinned (168) | 160 | 160 | 10/13 | 288 | 0/13 | yes (right 341) |
| 375 | pinned 65 (68) | 60 | 60 | 13/13 | 288 | 0/13 | yes |
| 375 | unpinned, right-edge column | 159 | 159 | 10/13 | 288 | 0/13 | yes (shifted, right 375) |
| 320 | all three grids | 60 to 160 | n/a | n/a | 288 | 0/13 | yes (right 320) |
| 260 | all three grids (narrower than the floor) | 60 to 160 | n/a | n/a | 260 (floor capped) | 1/13 | yes (right 260) |
| 1280 | unpinned (281) | 273 | 273 | 0/13 | 288 | 0/13 | yes |

</details>
